subject: general
question: Two trains having lengths of 410 m and 440 m are running at speeds of 130 km/hr and 140 km/hr, respectively, in the same direction. The time taken (in minutes) by the faster train, coming from behind, to completely cross the other train is:3385
solution:
**Given:**

Length of first train = 410

Length of second train = 440

Speed of first train = 130 km/hr

Speed of second train = 140 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed (same direction) = Faster speed - Slower speed

Time = Total distance ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 
410 + 440 = 850

⇒ Relative speed = 140 - 130 = 10 km/hr

⇒ Convert speed into m/min

⇒ 10 km/hr = 10 × 1000 ÷ 60

⇒ = 10000 ÷ 60

⇒ = 500 ÷ 3 m/min

⇒ Time = 850 ÷ (500 ÷ 3)

⇒ = 850 × 3 ÷ 500

⇒ = 2550 ÷ 500

⇒ = 5.1 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 5.1 minutes.**
